# `Time`

[Back to stdlib index](../stdlib.md)

Ipe.Time -- clock + formatting + parsing.

Clock reads (`now`, `unixMillis`) return a typed `Ipe.Time.Timestamp` (an
opaque millisecond-since-epoch instant).  Pure helpers (`format*`,
`timeString`) take a `Timestamp`.  Arithmetic helpers (`add`, `diff`)
compose `Timestamp` with `Ipe.Duration` — the only span type: invalid
arithmetic (adding two instants, subtracting a format-width from a clock
read) is a compile-time type error.  `sleep` and `every` continue to take a
typed `Ipe.Duration` span.

## `now`

```ipe
now : () -> Task Error Timestamp
```

`now ()` — the current instant.

## `unixMillis`

```ipe
unixMillis : () -> Task Error Timestamp
```

`unixMillis ()` — the current instant (alias for `now`).

## `sleep`

```ipe
sleep : Duration -> Task Error ()
```

`sleep span` -- resolve after `span` elapses.  Takes a typed
`Ipe.Duration` (e.g. `Duration.seconds 2`); the raw milliseconds are unwrapped
for the runtime kernel.

## `timeString`

```ipe
timeString : Timestamp -> String
```

`timeString t` — the UTC wall-clock time of `t` as `HH:MM:SS`.  Renders
instants in the calendar years -262143 to 262142; an instant outside them
ends in a typed `InvalidInput` error naming the function.

## `format`

```ipe
format : String -> Timestamp -> String
```

`format layout t` — format `t` in UTC by a Go reference-time `layout`,
which spells fields of `Mon Jan 2 15:04:05 MST 2006`: `2006` year, `01`
month, `02` day, `15` hour, `04` minute, `05` second, `Jan` month name,
`Mon` weekday name, `MST` zone (always `UTC`), `.000` milliseconds,
`.000000` microseconds, `PM` or `pm` the half of the day.  The longest
token wins at each position; every other character, `%` included, is
literal.  Renders instants in the calendar years -262143 to 262142; an
instant outside them ends in a typed `InvalidInput` error naming the
function.

## `formatHTTP`

```ipe
formatHTTP : Timestamp -> String
```

`formatHTTP t` — format `t` as an HTTP-date string (RFC 7231).  Renders
instants in the calendar years -262143 to 262142; an instant outside them
ends in a typed `InvalidInput` error naming the function.

## `formatISO8601`

```ipe
formatISO8601 : Timestamp -> String
```

`formatISO8601 t` — format `t` as an ISO 8601 string in UTC.  Renders
instants in the calendar years -262143 to 262142; an instant outside them
ends in a typed `InvalidInput` error naming the function.

## `formatRFC3339`

```ipe
formatRFC3339 : Timestamp -> String
```

`formatRFC3339 t` — format `t` as an RFC 3339 string in UTC.  Renders
instants in the calendar years -262143 to 262142; an instant outside them
ends in a typed `InvalidInput` error naming the function.

## `add`

```ipe
add : Duration -> Timestamp -> Timestamp
```

`add span t` — shift instant `t` forward by `span`.

## `diff`

```ipe
diff : Timestamp -> Timestamp -> Duration
```

`diff a b` — the `Duration` from instant `b` to instant `a`.  Clamped to
zero when `b` is after `a`.

## `fromMillis`

```ipe
fromMillis : Int -> Timestamp
```

`fromMillis ms` — build a `Timestamp` from raw milliseconds since the Unix
epoch.  Convenience alias for `Ipe.Time.Timestamp.fromUnixMillis`.

## `toMillis`

```ipe
toMillis : Timestamp -> Int
```

`toMillis t` — recover the raw millisecond value from a `Timestamp`.
Convenience alias for `Ipe.Time.Timestamp.toUnixMillis`.

## `addMillis`

```ipe
addMillis : Int -> Timestamp -> Timestamp
```

`addMillis ms t` — shift instant `t` by `ms` raw milliseconds.  Prefer
`add (Duration.millis ms)` for new code; this is provided for callers that
already hold a raw millisecond delta.  A shifted instant outside the
64-bit `Int` range ends in a typed `InvalidInput` error, as `+` does.

## `diffMillis`

```ipe
diffMillis : Timestamp -> Timestamp -> Int
```

`diffMillis a b` — raw milliseconds from instant `b` to instant `a`.
Prefer `Duration.toMillis (diff a b)` for new code.  A difference outside
the 64-bit `Int` range ends in a typed `InvalidInput` error, as `-` does.

## `every`

```ipe
every : Duration -> msg -> Sub msg
```

`every interval msg` -- Ipe.Web / Ipe.Tui subscription that emits `msg` once
per `interval`.  Takes a typed `Ipe.Duration` (e.g. `Duration.seconds 1`); the
raw milliseconds are unwrapped for the runtime kernel.  A non-positive
`interval` emits nothing.  In the browser a period longer than `2^31 - 1`
milliseconds (about 24.8 days) is capped at that maximum.

## `isLeapYear`

```ipe
isLeapYear : Int -> Bool
```

`isLeapYear year` — True when `year` is a leap year of the proleptic
Gregorian calendar.  Every `Int` year has an answer.

## `daysInMonth`

```ipe
daysInMonth : Int -> Int -> Int
```

`daysInMonth year month` — number of days in `month` (1 to 12) of `year`,
any `Int` year of the proleptic Gregorian calendar.  A month outside 1 to
12 ends in a typed `InvalidInput` error.
